children: Saatvik Green Energy share price likely to snap 3-day losing streak on September 16 following the company received an order worth Rs 1041.63 crore.
Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) has awarded an order for the supply of solar PV modules, with an aggregate order value of Rs 1,041.63 crore.
The order will be executed by December 2027.
Catch all the market action on our live blog

Earlier in this month, its material subsidiary i.e., Saatvik Solar Industries has received and accepted an order aggregating to Rs 297.5 crores from two renowned Independent Power producers/EPC Players for the supply of Solar PV Modules.
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 389.65, down Rs 6.65, or 1.68 percent.

The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 580.00 and a 52-week low of Rs 329.70 on 15 October, 2025 and 09 March, 2026, respectively. Currently, the stock is trading 32.82 percent below its 52-week high and 18.18 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 4,952.65 crore.

title: Saatvik Green Energy shares in focus on order win worth Rs 1041.63cr
